name: ui-section-framework
title: Sidebar section framework (header+collapse in shell)
description: Centralize .sb-section header rendering + collapse toggle in the sidebar component; panels mount body + optional header-actions slot. Derived from ui-spacing deep-dive. Design doc planned: schema panel -> { header: { label, collapsible, actionsSlot? }, mountBody(root) }. Pros: one collapse impl, kills per-panel applyCollapsibleSection dup, structural spacing consistency. Cons: header chrome slots (struct/integrity), scripts non-collapsible header + inner result collapse stay panel-owned, mount-contract test churn.
